behavior: The live Privy balances test passes reliably: find why the Balances page sometimes does not render within 5 s after its sidebar link is clicked
acceptance: The cause of e2e/privy/balances.spec.ts:116 failing in about 3 of 10 full e2e runs is found: the step still expected the pre-R-76 rule (switching profile keeps the page) and passed only when it read the old Balances heading before the navigation to /app; it now waits for /app and the Personal overview per R-76, then opens Balances; no timeout or retry is added; the spec passes 3 runs in a row and the full e2e suite passes
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Root cause right: switchProfile calls router.push(APP_ROUTES.home) (R-76), so the old step's Balances heading check only passed when read before navigation. New step waits for /app URL, the Personal overview heading and the Personal switcher label, then reopens Balances; a self-flipping profile would still fail the switcher check. Nothing weakened: no timeout or retry added, no check removed, the axe check after Transactions stays. Radix MenuRadioItem calls onValueChange even for the already-active value, so the no-network branch (Personal already active) still navigates. No other e2e spec asserts the keep-the-page rule (auth, navigation, onboarding, invoices, money-requests checked). pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck pass. Minor: the task refs R-66; R-76 is the requirement the step tests.
2026-10-15 Also covers R-76 (the post-switch step tests it); ref left as R-66 to keep the reviewed definition.

proof.1: e2e: the trace of the failed run shows the first Balances check passing and the failure at the post-switch check; the step now waits for /app and 'Personal overview' (R-76) and reopens Balances; balances.spec passed 3 runs in a row and the full e2e suite passes here
